name: pboc_get_exchange_rate
description:
Daily Chinese yuan per US dollar (DEXCHUS, noon buying rates in New York) from FRED.
Returns: series_code (FRED id, or IMF flow.key), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): currency_pair (usd_cny; default usd_cny); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
For euro or Canadian dollar crosses use ecb_get_exchange_rate with EUR/CNY or boc_get_exchange_rate. FRED series need FRED_API_KEY (config fred.api.key); without it they fail with a message saying so.
Example: {"currency_pair": "usd_cny", "recent_periods": 30}

recent_periods.description: The last N observations; used only when neither date is given
